summary: Everyday use of Business Central: basic settings, data entry, dates, search (Tell Me, Role Explorer, filters), notifications, errors, attachments, company switching, performance tips and Copilot. Subtopics cover Microsoft 365 apps, personalization, reports, document layouts, sharing and accessibility.
overview:
This section helps users work efficiently in Business Central after the first sign-in. Its own pages cover the basics: My Settings (role, company, work date, region, language, time zone, notifications), data entry techniques, date and time input, required fields, and ways to find things with Tell Me, Role Explorer, record search, and sort, search and filter options.

Further pages cover notifications, warnings and error messages, attachments, links and notes, switching company or environment, multilanguage and localization, performance tips and the Performance Profiler, camera and location troubleshooting, and Copilot (preview).

Six subtopics go deeper: Microsoft 365 apps, personalization, running and printing reports, changing document layouts, sharing business data, and accessibility with keyboard shortcuts and touch gestures. A good start is Working with Business Central, then Change Basic Settings and Finding Pages and Information with Tell Me.
key_points: My Settings manages role, company, work date, region, language, time zone and notifications.
Data entry pages cover Quick Entry, copy and paste, keyboard navigation, line item filtering and Copilot autofill.
Red asterisks mark fields expected for a process, but they do not enforce validation or block posting.
Tell Me finds actions, pages, reports, data and help. The Advanced tab adds AI-powered semantic search. Role Explorer offers a similar semantic search preview by role.
Filters support operators such as >, <, =, <>, |, .., &, * and ?, and tokens such as %me and %user. Modern search with word matching is described for 2024 release wave 1.
Warnings and errors can offer navigation links and can be shared through Teams or email.
Attachments, links and notes are managed in the FactBox Attachments tab, including on document lines.
Copilot in Business Central (preview) gives read-only question answering and is available starting in version 29.
